name: artifact_list
description: List Output files and per-file export results, including after Sandbox termination. completed=true is terminal, not necessarily successful: only EXPORTED with export_path means saved. STAGED is received but unscanned. wait_ms waits for ongoing explicit exports without starting a new one. Remaining current Output files are scanned and automatically saved only on CLEAN at normal Sandbox termination; failures remain unpublished.

limit.description: How many artifacts to return in one page.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous call, to get the following page.

wait_ms.description: Wait up to this many milliseconds for ongoing Output exports; timeout does not cancel them.
